981.s: I have seen our little coz., Cora, a fine, plump, rosy cheeked, black eyed girl, very pretty, and what the men would call desirable; plays and sings well, and is graceful in her manner; plus anglaise que française; she has neither money nor protection to undertake the journey proposed, yet she would suit that market; Mille choses d notre chère cousine.
